findings.basis: Per-network true entries in LineageOS device carrier config overlays (Fairphone FP4/FP5 for the AT, BE, CH, DE, DK, FR, GB, NL, NO and SE networks; OnePlus sm8350/dre for Verizon; Motorola/Nokia/Xelex/Xiaomi/LG trees for O2 DE, Jio, APT TW and SIMBA) and Sony Open Devices AOSP entries for EE, Virgin, Telia DK/FI, 3 SE, Tele2 SE, Verizon and the 310-26 entry. These are real shipped carrier config values. They are also identical to CarrierConfigManager's default (CarrierConfigManager.java:11864, true), which is what would be served otherwise because the Google lane leaves the key unset for all 95 profiles.
findings.effect: Domain selection is off on this ROM (empty config_domain_selection_service_component_name, packages/services/Telephony/res/values/config.xml:393, PhoneGlobals.java:520-525; DomainSelectionResolver.java:139-146; the phone's dumpsys on LineageOS 24.0 shows componentName=[]). The local tree tracks lineage-24.0 despite its directory name. In the legacy path the key is read only in GsmCdmaPhone.useImsForEmergency() (GsmCdmaPhone.java:1243-1252). When true and the ImsService is ready, an emergency call is first tried over IMS even when IMS is not registered for voice (:1337, :1422-1428). Telephony falls back to CS if the IMS dial throws (:1433-1437) or ImsStack reports CODE_LOCAL_CALL_CS_RETRY_REQUIRED/EXTRA_CODE_CALL_RETRY_EMERGENCY, which is its default for any failed emergency start (EmergencyStartErrorHandler.cpp:139-140; ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:3641-3685; Phone.java:847-876). The same gate allows the modem's EMC_REDIAL_ON_IMS / EMC_REDIAL_ON_VOWIFI retry (GsmCdmaCallTracker.java:1319-1332).
findings.risk: None from this change. Serving true equals the value Android already uses for these SIMs, so the emergency domain choice, the IMS-to-CS fallback and the CS-to-IMS retry stay exactly as they are. Nothing reads the key with containsKey or treats an explicit value differently. IMS-first is also the safer setting for this stack: Telephony tries IMS and falls back to CS, while false would mean CS only. Known ImsStack risks for IMS emergency calls (for example the dedicated-bearer wait while roaming, noted in the modem study) exist with or without this value.

notes: Proceed. The value equals Android's default, which these 95 profiles get otherwise, so serving it changes no emergency call path on LineageOS 24.0 with the AOSP ImsStack (legacy path, domain selection off). The basis is real per-carrier entries in LineageOS and Sony device overlays.
